headline: Micron NAND analog-design role assigns AI agents to circuit review and specification checks
fact: Micron posted Hyderabad Staff Engineer, Analog Design role JR113578 for NAND Flash circuits including charge pumps, regulators, ADCs/DACs, references and sensor interfaces. It assigns development and evaluation of AI agents for specification-to-check extraction, schematic or connectivity review, and verification debug. Reusable workflows connect engineering data, scripts, simulation outputs and design checks, with validation and human review before decisions. These pre-silicon review tasks extend beyond the separate layout-automation and simulation-orchestration duties; the posting does not establish AI-generated circuit topology or achieved deployment benefits.

sources.title: Micron Careers: Staff Engineer, Analog Design (JR113578)
sources.summary: Official Workday startDate is September 30, 2026. The NAND analog role explicitly assigns agent prototypes for specification-to-check extraction, schematic/connectivity review and debug, with evaluation criteria and human validation.
